paper.title: Algorithm 584: CUBTRI, automatic cubature over a triangle (ACM TOMS Algorithm 584)

claim.text: Integral of EXP(SIN(X)*COS(Y)) over the triangle (0,1),(0,0),(1,0), computed by CUBTRI at EPS=1E-3 (MCALLS=20000, NW=5000), IER expected 0. The reference is the driver's ACTUAL(4) = .6918104506612316 (16 digits, credited to Haegemans 1977). Registered tol_abs 6.918104506612316e-4 (1e-3 relative to the reference), fixed before the run.

reference.archive: netlib.org/toms/584.gz sha256 f5b9249f64e069d4e7bdaca43854c5bf73b06c1973a0eec99b3333e60810410e (driver lines 1-40: ACTUAL(4) at line 36, sequence column MAN 330)

attempt: The archive's single file compiled and linked as shipped with gfortran 16 -O2 -std=legacy (one main program KONYN plus subprograms F, CUBTRI, RNDERR, CUBRUL), no edit; run with no input. Driver row for integrand 4 at EPS=1.E-03: ANS 0.691810429096, IER 0. Printed to 12 decimals (F15.12); the driver's own ACTUAL is single precision so its ACTUAL-ERROR column reads 0.0.

original_attempt.reason: Compiled and linked as shipped; ran with exit 0. Only a Fortran 95 'H format' deletion warning, no error.
